question: Where within the inner ten-spoked enclosure are the deities to be placed?
premises: The location is the inner ten-spoked enclosure
Placements are on the two sides
Placements are likewise at the fronts
inference: Within the inner ten-spoked enclosure, the deities are placed on the sides and at the fronts.
uncertainties: The specific deities are named in the next verse
plain_english: O lady of the gods, in the inner ten-spoked enclosure, they are placed on the sides and likewise at the fronts.
